column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
a bound moment on the first row of a 3,000-row stance table is not named unconsidered
a candidate grounded on the first of 9,000 declared probes is accepted
a candidate repeating the first of 9,000 admitted obligations is refused as already admitted
a capability 6,000 stack rows serve is reported served among the gaps
a checker the gate prints that sorts first of 3,002 qualified checkers is not called ungoverned
a checker whose first of 25,000 rows declares a control is short only the three controls it never declares
a content row matching the first of more added lines than a pipe holds still raises the tier
a declined moment wired as the first of 3,000 bound events reads missing
a grant merged first among thousands is not listed as written and not merged
a judge identical to the tree is refused when the engine path sorts first of many
a line outside a risk row's confine near the top of a diff larger than a pipe still fires the row
a live night whose state file runs past a pipe after its first line reads live
a routine name holding a newline is refused, even when its lines are two adjacent routines
a run of the first routine is recorded however many routines follow it
a wired moment bound as the first of 3,000 bound events reads ok
an unknown evidence row is not an all-clear however much text follows it
and writes no fold for that machine session into memory
destructive SQL on the first added line of a diff larger than a pipe still escapes as durable
felix ledger folds the person's session and passes over the first of many machine sessions
no engine test pipes into a grep that can stop reading early
session-start does not count the first of many machine sessions as stranded, only the person's beside it
the felix marketplace root is read, and reported read, from an entry listing more than a pipe holds
